00010       ORG 40000
00020       ENT
00030       LD HL,MESS
00040       CALL MAIN
00050       RET
00060 ;
00070 ;*********************
00080 ;   START OF ROUTINE
00090 ;*********************
00100 ;
00110 MAIN  DI
00120       PUSH HL
00130       LD HL,15616  ;CSET
00140       DEC H
00150       LD (CHR),HL
00160       CALL TABLE
00170       POP IX
00180 ;
00190 ;*******************
00200 ;  MAIN LOOP
00210 ;*******************
00220 ;
00230 LP    LD A,(IX+0)
00240       CP 255
00250       JR Z,END
00260       CP 32
00270       CALL C,CONTR
00280       LD H,0
00290       LD L,A
00300       ADD HL,HL
00310       ADD HL,HL
00320       ADD HL,HL
00330       EX DE,HL
00340       LD HL,(CHR)
00350       ADD HL,DE
00360       LD BC,BACK
00370       PUSH BC
00380 VECT  JP NORM
00390 END   EI
00400       RET
00410 BACK  INC IX
00420       XOR A
00430       CALL ATTR
00440       LD A,(FL)
00450       AND A
00460       JR Z,OK
00470       XOR A
00480       CALL SEC
00490 OK    LD A,(AT)
00500       CALL ATTR
00510       LD A,(FL)
00520       AND A
00530       JR Z,OK2
00540       LD A,(AT+1)
00550       CALL SEC
00560 OK2   CALL WAIT
00570       CALL BEEP
00580       JR LP
00590 ;
00600 ;*********************
00610 ; NORMAL LETTERS
00620 ;*********************
00630 ;
00640 NORM  LD B,8
00650       LD DE,(ST)
00660 L00   LD A,(HL)
00670       CALL FAT
00680       LD (DE),A
00690       INC D
00700       INC HL
00710       DJNZ L00
00720       CALL RIGHT
00730       RET
00740 ;
00750 ;*********************
00760 ; DOUBLE IMAGE
00770 ;*********************
00780 ;
00790 ONE   LD B,8
00800       LD DE,(ST)
00810 L1    LD A,(HL)
00820       CALL FAT
00830       LD (DE),A
00840       INC D
00850       INC HL
00860       DJNZ L1
00870       DEC HL
00880       DEC HL
00890       DEC HL
00900       DEC HL
00910       CALL DOWN
00920       CALL HALF
00930       CALL RIGHT
00940       RET
00950 ;
00960 ;*********************
00970 ; MIDDLE-OF-THE-LINE
00980 ;*********************
00990 ;
01000 TWO   LD DE,(ST)
01010       INC D
01020       INC D
01030       INC D
01040       INC D
01050       CALL HALF
01060       CALL DOWN
01070       CALL HALF
01080       CALL RIGHT
01090       RET
01100 ;
01110 ;*********************
01120 ;  DOUBLE HEIGHT
01130 ;*********************
01140 ;
01150 THR   LD DE,(ST)
01160       CALL DOUBL
01170       CALL DOWN
01180       CALL DOUBL
01190       CALL RIGHT
01200       RET
01210 ;
01220 ;*********************
01230 ; D.HEIGHT STRIPED
01240 ;*********************
01250 ;
01260 FOU   LD DE,(ST)
01270       CALL STRIP
01280       CALL DOWN
01290       CALL STRIP
01300       CALL RIGHT
01310       RET
01320 ;
01330 ;*********************
01340 ; SUBROUTINES
01350 ;*********************
01360 ;
01370 DOWN  LD DE,(ST)
01380       RR D
01390       RR D
01400       RR D
01410       PUSH HL
01420       LD HL,32
01430       ADD HL,DE
01440       EX DE,HL
01450       POP HL
01460       RL D
01470       RL D
01480       RL D
01490       RET
01500 ;
01510 ;******************
01520 ;
01530 RIGHT LD DE,(ST)
01540       RR D
01550       RR D
01560       RR D
01570       INC DE
01580       RL D
01590       RL D
01600       RL D
01610       LD (ST),DE
01620       RET
01630 ;
01640 ;******************
01650 ;
01660 HALF  LD B,4
01670 L31   LD A,(HL)
01680       CALL FAT
01690       LD (DE),A
01700       INC D
01710       INC HL
01720       DJNZ L31
01730       RET
01740 ;
01750 ;*******************
01760 ;
01770 DOUBL LD B,4
01780 L41   LD A,(HL)
01790       CALL FAT
01800       LD (DE),A
01810       INC D
01820       LD (DE),A
01830       INC HL
01840       INC D
01850       DJNZ L41
01860       RET
01870 ;
01880 ;*******************
01890 ;
01900 STRIP LD B,4
01910 L51   LD A,(HL)
01920       CALL FAT
01930       LD (DE),A
01940       INC D
01950       XOR A
01960       LD (DE),A
01970       INC D
01980       INC HL
01990       DJNZ L51
02000       RET
02010 ;
02020 ;*******************
02030 ;
02040 FAT   RET     ;NOP FOR
02050       RRA
02060       OR (HL)
02070       RET
02080 ;
02090 ;******************
02100 ;  ATTRIBUTES
02110 ;******************
02120 ;
02130 ATTR  LD HL,(ST)
02140       DEC HL
02150       EX AF,AF'
02160       LD A,H
02170       AND 24
02180       SRA A
02190       SRA A
02200       SRA A
02210       ADD A,88
02220       LD H,A
02230       EX AF,AF'
02240       LD (HL),A
02250       RET
02260 SEC   LD DE,32
02270       ADD HL,DE
02280       LD (HL),A
02290       RET
02300 ;
02310 ;*********************
02320 ; LINE ADDRESSES
02330 ;*********************
02340 ;
02350 TABLE LD H,91  ;AT 23296
02360       LD L,0
02370       PUSH HL
02380       POP IX
02390       LD H,64
02400       LD D,L
02410       LD E,32
02420       LD B,24
02430 LOOP  LD (IX+0),L
02440       LD (IX+1),H
02450       RR H
02460       RR H
02470       RR H
02480       ADD HL,DE
02490       RL H
02500       RL H
02510       RL H
02520       INC IX
02530       INC IX
02540       DJNZ LOOP
02550       RET
02560 ;
02570 ;*******************
02580 ;
02590 CONTR LD A,(IX+0)
02600       CP 24
02610       JR C,LINOK
02620 OOSCR EI    ;OFF SCREEN
02630       RST 8 ;LIMITS
02640       DEFB 4
02650 LINOK LD A,(IX+1)
02660       CP 32
02670       JR NC,OOSCR
02680       LD C,(IX+1)
02690       LD L,(IX+2)
02700       LD H,(IX+3)
02710       LD (AT),HL
02720       LD H,91    ;23296
02730       LD L,(IX+0)
02740       RLC L
02750       LD A,(HL)
02760       OR C
02770       INC L
02780       LD H,(HL)
02790       LD L,A
02800       LD (ST),HL
02810       INC IX
02820       INC IX
02830       INC IX
02840       INC IX
02850       CALL WAIT ;PAUSE
02860       CALL WAIT ;BETWEEN
02870       CALL WAIT ;SEN/CES
02880       LD A,(IX+0)
02890       CP 32
02900       CALL C,TYPE
02910       RET
02920 TYPE  CP 5
02930       JR C,HERE
02940       EI
02950       RST 8  ;MODE NUMBER
02960       DEFB 5 ;TOO BIG
02970 HERE  CALL MODE
02980       INC IX
02990       LD A,(IX+0)
03000       RET
03010 MODE  LD HL,ROUT
03020       LD (FL),A
03030       ADD A,A
03040       LD D,0
03050       LD E,A
03060       ADD HL,DE
03070       LD DE,VECT+1
03080       LD A,(HL)
03090       LD (DE),A
03100       INC DE
03110       INC HL
03120       LD A,(HL)
03130       LD (DE),A
03140       RET
03150 ;
03160 ;*********************
03170 ;    PAUSE
03180 ;*********************
03190 ;
03200 WAIT  NOP ;RET FOR NO
03210       LD BC,4000  ;PAUSE
03220 W2    DEC BC
03230       LD A,B
03240       OR C
03250       JR NZ,W2
03260       RET
03270 ;
03280 ;**********************
03290 ;    SOUND
03300 ;**********************
03310 ;
03320 BEEP  NOP  ;RET FOR NO
03330       LD DE,2000 ;BEEP
03340 BP    LD A,(DE)
03350       AND 16
03360       OR 0      ;BORDER 0
03370       OUT (254),A
03380       DEC DE
03390       LD A,D
03400       OR E
03410       JR NZ,BP
03420       RET
03430 ;
03440 ;**********************
03450 ;   VARIABLES
03460 ;**********************
03470 ;
03480 ST    DEFW 0
03490 FL    DEFB 0
03500 CHR   DEFW 15616
03510 ROUT  DEFW NORM,ONE,TWO
03520       DEFW THR,FOU
03530 AT    DEFW 0
03540 ;
03550 ;************************
03560 ;*       MESSAGE        *
03570 ;************************
03580 ;*                      *
03590 ;* CONTROL CODES ARE    *
03600 ;* ALWAYS THE FIRST     *
03610 ;* FOUR OR FIVE BYTES   *
03620 ;* OF A STRING IN THIS  *
03630 ;* ORDER:               *
03640 ;*----------------------*
03650 ;* 1.LINE (0-23)        *
03660 ;* 2.ROW  (0-31)        *
03670 ;* 3.TOP COLOUR  (0-255)*
03680 ;* 4.BTTM COLOUR (0-255)*
03690 ;* 5.CHR MODE (0-4)>>>  *
03700 ;*  >>WHICH IS OPTIONAL *
03710 ;*----------------------*
03720 ;* ALWAYS END MESSAGE   *
03730 ;* WITH 255.            *
03740 ;* IN MODES 1,3,4 MAKE  *
03750 ;* SURE THAT MESSAGES   *
03760 ;* DO NOT EXCEED A LINE *
03770 ;* IN LEN,AND THAT LINE *
03780 ;* NUMBERS INCREMENT    *
03790 ;* BY 2.                *
03800 ;************************
03810 ;
03820 MESS  DEFB 00,01,70,66,0
03830       DEFM /> Computer P/
03840       DEFM /rogrammed
03850       DEFB 02,05,68,69,1
03860       DEFM /> By Theo/
03870       DEFM / Develegas/
03880       DEFB 09,03,67,68,2
03890       DEFB 127
03900       DEFM / HELL*ENIC
03910       DEFM / SOFTWARE
03920       DEFM / 1988
03930       DEFB 12,2,5,6,3
03940       DEFM / Samantha F
03950       DEFM /ox .../
03960       DEFB 13,19,4,66,4
03970       DEFM /(WAHAY !)
03980       DEFB 255  ; E N D !
